title: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series Manila 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Big-Cat Brand Race at SM MOA
seo_title: PUMA Half Marathon Manila 2026 Review | SM MOA Philippines
meta_description: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series Manila Leg 2026: October 11 at SM Mall of Asia. 21K, 10K, 5K from RUNRIO with registration open — a global sportswear brand race reviewed.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this PUMA-branded half marathon series is produced by RUNRIO. Three distances with registration open. A global sportswear brand's Philippine road race.
verdict: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series Manila Leg combines two premium forces in Philippine road racing: RUNRIO's gold-standard production and PUMA's global sportswear brand presence. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) at SM Mall of Asia — Manila Bay's iconic waterfront venue — with registration open. PUMA's brand involvement typically means quality race merchandise (expect well-designed singlets and finisher shirts) and a polished finish-line experience. For runners wanting a brand-backed, RUNRIO-produced half marathon at a proven Manila venue, this is a top-tier pick.

sections.heading: PUMA + RUNRIO: A Premium Combination
paragraphs: PUMA's sportswear brand presence pairs with RUNRIO's race-production expertise — the same team behind the MILO Marathon National Finals. [1] SM Mall of Asia provides a flat, waterfront course with excellent transport links and post-race dining built into the venue.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A PUMA-RUNRIO collaboration at SM MOA — one of the Philippines' best-produced, best-branded half marathon experiences. Registration open. 11 October 2026. [1]
